body: ## Motivation With MTP (NEXTN) speculative decoding under spec-v2 overlap scheduling, each decode step consists of three CUDA graphs: ``` [draft graph] NEXTN draft model, k autoregressive passes -> draft-token chain [verify graph] target model, one forward over the draft tokens (TARGET_VERIFY) [extend graph] draft model backfills KV for the accepted tokens (DRAFT_EXTEND) ``` Between the graphs live eager "seams": accept sampling, cache-slot assignment, attention-metadata rebuild, next-step draft input preparation. At low concurrency (bs=1 to small batches) these seams, host-side Python dispatch and per-step synchronization the GPU cannot overlap, become GPU idle time. ### Host run-ahead, and what pins it sglang's `event_loop_overlap` is designed so that while the GPU executes step N, the host is already assembling and enqueuing step N+1; the host stays off the critical path iff **host loop time < GPU step time**. The `FutureMap` keeps cross-step data (next tokens, new_seq_lens, draft seeds) GPU-resident, relayed by pool index between graphs, so the host can launch the next step without ever seeing accept results, launch-queue depth grows to ~1 full step of run-ahead: Several per-step host costs, however, still pin the host to the GPU's progress and shrink that run-ahead back toward lockstep: 1. **A blocking per-step seq_lens D2H stream sync for KDA hybrids.** `KDAAttnBackend` never declared `needs_cpu_seq_lens`, inheriting the base-class `True`, which forces `FutureMap.resolve_seq_lens_cpu` onto the blocking path (`fwd_prepare_d2h_stream.synchronize()` every step). In bs=1 MTP traces of a KDA-hybrid model this stall measured ~0.5 ms/step median — the host waits for the previous verify to finish on GPU, zeroing run-ahead. GDN / Mamba2 / ShortConv siblings already declare `False` and run the same base-class metadata code. 2. **Hybrid wrappers drop the verify-buffer hooks.** `HybridLinearAttnBackend` never forwarded `get/update_verify_buffers_to_fill_after_draft`, so every hybrid-linear MTP model takes the `[None, None]` fallback: the draft stage cannot write the tree mask / positions straight into the full-attn child's captured verify buffers and instead allocates a fresh `custom_mask` each step — sized `bs * max_context_len` once the GPU-only seq_lens path nulls `seq_lens_sum`. 3. **An eager end-offset add in verify prep.** `eagle_prepare_for_verify` extends every row by exactly `draft_token_num` tokens, yet materialized `seq_lens + draft_token_num` on the host (a fresh tensor + a dispatch per step) for the generic cache-locs kernel, which then re-derived per-row output offsets with O(bs) cross-row prefix-sum loads. 4. **A 5-7 dispatch replay-prep chain.** `_replay_metadata` refreshed `state_indices_list` via separate aten ops (zero padded `req_pool_indices` rows → mapping gather → v2p translate → `-1` padding sentinel → `copy_` into the static buffer) on every mamba-backend CUDA-graph replay. **The host seam is a serial chain** — single-point savings do not add up: remove A and the CPU immediately hits B. What ultimately hides the host is the combination plus the overlap scheduling itself, not any single item. The latency payoff therefore lands as a bundle; each fix is nonetheless independently correct and independently revertible. ### Effects Before PR, GPU bubbles between draft_extend/draft/target_verify are significant: After PR, GPU bubbles between these tree APIs are almost gone: Whole picture before PR, no overlap, CUDA graph launch is sync: After PR, the verify CUDA graph launch can be overlapped in the next draft_extend: ### Provenance These items were developed and measured in a bs=1 MTP decode optimization campaign on a KDA-hybrid MoE model (4× B200, TP4, NEXTN speculative decoding), whose end state reached **~90% GPU busy per step** with the host fully hidden behind the GPU — the per-item trace measurements quoted in this PR (the ~0.5 ms/step D2H stall) come from that campaign. This PR upstreams the model-agnostic host-seam subset; every item passed the campaign's correctness gate (byte-exact 256-token greedy output + accept length invariance) before it stayed. ## Modifications One commit per item, bit-identical by construction (scheduling / fusion only — no numerical path changes): - **`Opt KDA backend out of the per-step seq_lens_cpu D2H sync`** — `KDAAttnBackend` declares `needs_cpu_seq_lens = False`, matching GDN/Mamba2/ShortConv. Safety: the shared `MambaAttnBackendBase` metadata never reads the spec-v2 CPU mirror for KDA — replay padding always comes from `forward_batch.num_padding`, and the replayssm track-flush mask reads are `not is_kda`-gated. With the full-attn siblings (trtllm_mla / fa3 / flashmla / triton) already `False`, the OR over spec-v2 backends can now stay `False` for KDA hybrids and the per-step stream sync disappears. - **`Forward verify-buffer hooks through HybridLinearAttnBackend`** — `get` delegates to the full-attn child (the linear side consumes no mask); the draft stage now writes directly into the captured verify buffers and the per-step mask allocation disappears. `update` forwards to both children with an explicit no-op on `MambaAttnBackendBase` (mamba plan-time metadata is draft-output independent); children without an implementation keep the fail-loud `NotImplementedError`, so an unvetted plan-stream combination fails loudly instead of silently reading stale buffers. - **`Fuse the uniform verify-prep cache-locs end offsets into the kernel`** — new `assign_extend_cache_locs_uniform`: end offset computed in-kernel (`start + draft_token_num`), output offset a direct `pid * draft_token_num`. NPU / CPU fall back to the end_offset-tensor reference path unchanged; the non-uniform call site (`move_accept_tokens`) keeps the reference kernel. - **`Fuse the mamba replay-prep state-indices chain into one launch`** — `_fused_state_indices_kernel` does the gather + sentinel + store in a single triton launch, preserving the reference chain's side effect of zeroing padded `req_pool_indices` rows (captured kernels gather with that buffer). Gated to CUDA + the static hybrid pool whose v2p translate is the identity + replayssm off; unified-pool / replayssm configs keep the reference chain. - **`Add bit-exact reference test for _fused_state_indices_kernel`** — see Accuracy Tests. Compatibility: no API / flag changes; NPU, CPU, unified-memory pool, and replayssm behavior unchanged (explicit gates / fallbacks); plan-stream fail-loud contract preserved. ## Accuracy Tests - **New unit test** `test/registered/attention/unittests/hybrid_linear/test_fused_state_indices_kernel.py`: fused kernel vs the reference aten chain on guard-padded buffers, bs ∈ {1, 2, 7, 32, 33} × num_padding sweep × 3 seeds + a non-injective-mapping case — asserts bit-identical state indices (incl. `-1` sentinels), the `req_pool_indices` zeroing side effect, and untouched guard tails (out-of-range write protection for `BS_UPPER > bs`). Result on H20-3e: **2 tests, 45 subtests, all pass (8.8s)**. - **e2e greedy byte-identity, branch vs base (`b98a577f`), H20-3e, tp=4** (greedy, 8 fixed prompts, 256 tokens each, `ignore_eos`): - `Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` + **NEXTN MTP** (`--speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`) — a GDN-hybrid spec-v2 config exercising items 2-4: output text **byte-identical**; per-prompt `spec_verify_ct` **identical** (113/91/71/83/84/83/85/80) — acceptance behavior unchanged. - `Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct` plain CUDA-graph decode — a KDA config exercising item 4's fused replay path: output **byte-identical**. ## Speed Tests and Profiling These changes remove host-side work whose payoff is latency at low concurrency and compounds with sibling optimizations (serial chain): - Item 1 removes a measured ~0.5 ms/step median blocking stream sync (bs=1 MTP trace, KDA-hybrid lineage) once a KDA-hybrid spec-v2 config is active; it is inert (flag read only by `decide_needs_cpu_seq_lens`) for all other configs. - Item 2 removes a per-step `bs * max_context_len` bool-mask allocation for every hybrid-linear MTP model. - Items 3-4 replace 6-8 per-step host dispatches with 2 kernel launches. Byte-identical outputs above double as the no-regression evidence. A bundle-level TPOT A/B on Blackwell for the KDA-hybrid MTP target is part of the follow-up series and will be reported there. This is one part of hybrid-linear model optimazations, with which GPU utils increase from 67% to 95% in MTP. ## Checklist - [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :no_entry_sign: [Run #30326134766](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30326134766) Latest PR Test (Extra): :white_check_mark: [Run #30889987619](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/30889987619)

commits.messageBody:
KDAAttnBackend never declared needs_cpu_seq_lens and inherited the
base-class True, forcing FutureMap.resolve_seq_lens_cpu onto the
blocking path: a per-step fwd_prepare_d2h_stream.synchronize() that
stalls the scheduler ~0.5 ms (median 485 us over 30 traced steps, B200
bs=1 MTP) waiting for the previous verify to finish on GPU and publish
new_seq_lens, zeroing the spec-v2 host run-ahead.

KDA metadata never reads the spec-v2 seq_lens_cpu mirror: replay
padding comes from forward_batch.num_padding, and the replayssm
track-flush mask paths are gated `not is_kda`. GDNAttnBackend and
Mamba2AttnBackend already run the same base-class metadata code with
needs_cpu_seq_lens = False; this brings KDA into the same GPU-only
contract. With the full-attn siblings (trtllm_mla / fa3 / flashmla /
triton) all False, the OR over spec-v2 backends now stays False for
KDA hybrids (e.g. Kimi-Linear MTP) and the per-step stream sync
disappears entirely.
commits.messageHeadline: Opt KDA backend out of the per-step seq_lens_cpu D2H sync

commits.messageBody:
The hybrid wrapper never overrode the
get/update_verify_buffers_to_fill_after_draft hooks, so every
hybrid-linear MTP model (GDN / KDA) hit the base [None, None]: the
draft stage could not write the tree mask / positions straight into
the full-attn child's captured verify buffers and instead allocated a
fresh custom_mask every step -- sized bs * max_context_len once the
GPU-only seq_lens path (needs_cpu_seq_lens=False) nulls seq_lens_sum.

- get: delegate to the full-attn child (the linear side consumes no
  mask); the draft stage now writes into the captured verify buffers
  and the per-step mask allocation disappears.
- update: forward to both children. MambaAttnBackendBase gets an
  explicit no-op (mamba plan-time metadata -- state slot indices,
  per-bs static query_start_loc -- is draft-output independent);
  children without an implementation keep the fail-loud
  NotImplementedError, so an unvetted plan-stream combination fails
  loudly instead of silently reading stale buffers. The update site
  only fires under SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM (default off).

eagle_prepare_for_verify extends every row by exactly draft_token_num
tokens, yet went through the generic assign_extend_cache_locs kernel:
the host eagerly materialized `seq_lens + draft_token_num` (a fresh
tensor + one dispatch per step on the bs=1 MTP inter-phase seam) and
the kernel re-derived per-row output offsets with O(bs) cross-row
prefix-sum loads.

Add assign_extend_cache_locs_uniform: the end offset is computed in
the kernel (start + draft_token_num) and the output offset is a direct
pid * draft_token_num. NPU / CPU fall back to the end_offset-tensor
reference path, unchanged. The non-uniform call site
(move_accept_tokens: seq_lens + num_correct_drafts + 1) keeps the
reference kernel.
commits.messageHeadline: Fuse the uniform verify-prep cache-locs end offsets into the kernel

commits.messageBody:
_replay_metadata refreshed state_indices_list through a chain of
dispatched aten ops on the bs=1 MTP host critical path: zero padded
req_pool_indices rows, mamba mapping gather, v2p translate, -1
padding sentinel, copy_ into the static buffer (5 dispatches on the
static pool, more on the unified pool).

_fused_state_indices_kernel does the gather + sentinel + store in a
single triton launch, preserving the reference chain's side effect of
zeroing padded req_pool_indices rows (captured kernels gather with
them; dropping the zeroing would be a delayed illegal memory access).
Gated to CUDA + the static hybrid pool whose v2p translate is the
identity, and to replayssm off; the unified pool's allocator translate
is not a flat table gather, so those configs keep the reference chain.
commits.messageHeadline: Fuse the mamba replay-prep state-indices chain into one launch

commits.messageBody:
Drives the fused single-launch replay-prep path and the reference aten
chain on guard-padded buffers across a bs x num_padding matrix
(non-power-of-two sizes exercise the BS_UPPER masking) and asserts
bit-identical results: state indices incl. the -1 padding sentinels,
the req_pool_indices zeroing side effect (captured kernels gather with
that buffer; a missed zeroing is a delayed illegal memory access, not
a visible diff), and untouched guard tails past total_bs. Also covers
non-injective mappings (requests sharing a mamba slot).

commits.messageHeadline: Refresh tree links in the mamba plan-stream verify fixup hook
Move the fused replay state-indices kernel into kernels.ops.mamba

title: [MTP] Cut spec-v2 host-seam overhead in hybrid-linear MTP decode
